resources.string: N-LIC is currently running as a VPN, but Android does not expose a physical connection for diagnostics. Temporarily disconnect N-LIC, test the network directly, then restore the VPN? During the test N-LIC will be disconnected: other apps may also access the internet without its filtering, and existing connections will be interrupted. Other VPN apps will not be changed.

LIC-Core PREVIEW: this APK includes experimental sing-box. It uses the existing Android VPN/HEV path. Compatibility issues are possible. LIC-Bay is optional and cannot guarantee censorship bypass.

Uses local ByeDPI SOCKS only for the VPN server uplink TCP transport. Disable LIC-Bay if the connection fails.
UDP uses SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE. If your carrier blocks UDP itself, LIC-Bay may not help; switch server or protocol.
Parameters compile to sing-box JSON. The actual VPN connection has not been validated.
No selected server or its settings are unsupported. Connection is disabled.

In LIC-Core mode, sing-box tests up to 12 encrypted VPN outbounds using HTTPS, selects a lower-latency working server and checks again every 10 minutes without interrupting existing connections. Requires Core Preview.
Reconnect using the selected server, LIC-Auto and LIC-Bay. Readiness is verified over HTTPS through the tunnel.

Step 3 · Connect. Try without LIC-Bay first.

1. In the main N-LIC settings, choose VPN mode.
2. Import your HTTPS subscription or paste vless://, trojan:// or other connection links.
3. Select a server below.
4. Tap Connect and approve the Android VPN prompt.
5. Once connected, try LIC-Auto. Enable LIC-Bay for TCP servers only if necessary.

This is experimental software. Check your connection, DNS and IPv6 yourself; leak protection is not guaranteed.
